notes: Posted 3 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'start': Profit, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Han Solo, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and Insurrection; these count toward the 60. Podrace Prep is posted under Interrupts (it deploys Boonta Eve Podrace, the arena and the podracer) and is set as the starting interrupt; Insurrection is the starting Effect (strategy: 'which is why i start insurection').
Posted 'han' dested Han Solo (past ruling; the post does not name a version).
The 'stix(4)' section: 'lukes' dested Luke's Lightsaber, 'anakins' Anakin's Lightsaber, 'bens' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, 'quigons' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber.

Posted 'jabbas palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'weapon levitation' the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; 'docking bay 94' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'boshuda' Bo Shuda; 'frigrin d'an' Figrin D'an; 'lando w/ ax' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'jar jar' Jar Jar Binks; 'ben' Ben Kenobi; 'luke jk' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'qui gon' Qui-Gon Jinn; 'chewbacca' the A New Hope Chewbacca.
Posted 'enter the arena' dested Entering The Arena; 'sense and recoil' Sense & Recoil In Fear; 'alter and friendly fire' Alter & Friendly Fire; 'a jedis resiliance' A Jedi's Resilience.
